description: <primary checkout>/.terminalx/settings.json (shared in Git) and .terminalx/settings.local.json (ignored). Precedence, highest first: managed policy, repository local, repository shared, user, defaults. Unknown keys are ignored.

$schema.description: The JSON schema editors check this file against.

branchPrefix.description: Prefix for new workspace branches and for which branches workspace cleanup recognizes, such as "team/". Slash-separated parts of ASCII letters, digits, hyphens and underscores. Empty disables prefix-based cleanup. A shared value needs the person's trust.

environment.description: Literal environment variables for sessions started in this repository; never expanded. Values are at most 64 KiB. Shared values need the person's trust.

title: TerminalX repository settings
